integrity: The full result and analytic proof have been reviewed for consistency with a finite independent convex-hull numerical checker; the numerical checker is corroboration, not an infinite proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only convex hulls of two coaxial congruent regular planar polygons; fixed n>=3, no claim for unequal bases, off-axis shifts or arbitrary polyhedra. General mixed-area and polytope-volume formulas are pre-existing ingredients. Historical priority against unindexed specialization is not certified.
title: Half-step twist is the unique isoperimetric optimizer among two-ring regular prismatoids
